name: Jayda Silvestri
source: Jayda is Maisy's childhood best friend. Syd got to know her through Maisy, and it wasn't long before Jayda fell head-over-heels for Syd. She's a complete dork and weeaboo. She will happily gush about anime, video games, and art at anytime. She's bubbly, endearing, and honest to a fault. But she also has trouble standing up for herself and believing in her own ability. She spends her free time gaming, drawing and indulging in her inner weeb.
